gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. All presets off. Noah witnessed the bo v4 snap hook and READ miss 48. V5 follows the loaded team book and adds cancelable native give, keep, pitch and RPO pass. Protected integration is in WIRING.md.

input_constraints: Pinned USA XBE or verified composed input; reserve the complete owner union before installing bytes.
At most two authored read plays, bound to exact PLAY/compiler receipt pairs. An empty table makes no gameplay decisions; diagnostic mode still reports misses.
RPO receiver must be slot 7 or 8; receiver slot 6 shares the snap button. Native speed options are excluded.
Installed v1 through v4 owners require a clean rebuild. Fingerprints must identify a unique play in the final paired resource.
Use diagnostic=True or --diagnostic for the READ resource-number line. Diagnostic CPU reads give. Normal CPU reads the snap edge. Both variants retain 2048 RX, 256 RW and 88 RO bytes.
portme: Follow ASTRA_READ_OPTION_V5_REPORT.md: photograph READ 155/157 snap, pend and the decision; use 134/31 for a separately paired Gun build. The exact cause of the old live 48 remains unproved.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute the generated game executable or disc.

runtime.scope: Noah witnessed the v4 snap hook and HUD on bo. V5 is unwitnessed. Bounded native replays execute the gameplay PLAY loader, menu accessor, assignment prefix, frame dispatcher, delayed snap reception, handoff initialization and ownership event, both animation destructors, carry/pitch/pass initialization and FONT4 glyph renderer. Controller samples, receive-snap entry and ball arrival, post-snap poses, collision-free approach positions, exchange events, task storage and font residency are supplied. Neutral clip initialization, CPU downfield running AI, aiming and GPU/asset leaves are named boundaries. They do not prove natural animation timing, pass release/catch, lateral catch, contact behavior or live engagement.

selectors.notes: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Retail: original option controls. Patch: paired reads begin a native handoff after the snap. Do nothing to give. Before the ball leaves the QB, press Black to pull and pitch, or release A after snapping and press A again to pull and keep. On an RPO, press X or the named receiver button to pull and pass. These are Xbox button names; use your controller mapping. The stick waits until the decision. The CPU reads the unblocked edge. Noah witnessed the v4 snap hook and READ line, but these new controls and the animated exchange are unwitnessed. All presets are off. The READ diagnostic lasts until native reset.
